summary: Iteration 257: Wake Server Button Bug Fix VERIFIED. The CORS-with-credentials issue has been fixed. Button now transitions from 'Sunucuyu uyandır' to green 'Hazır (100ms)' state in ~0.8 seconds (well under 2s target). Network request sent WITHOUT credentials (withCredentials=false). Toast notification 'Sunucu hazır (100 ms · 1. deneme)' displays correctly. Login flow works normally after wake.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wake server button bug fix verified. The fix in LoginPage.js:28-31 sets withCredentials=false on the /api/health/live axios call, bypassing the CORS issue where Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is incompatible with credentials. Button transitions to green 'Hazır' state in <1 second on first attempt.

button_state_persistence.note: Button keeps green 'Hazır' state until page reload

bug_fix_verification.original_issue: Wake server button not working - clicking didn't wake server
bug_fix_verification.root_cause: axios.defaults.withCredentials=true globally set, but /api/health/live returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which is incompatible with credentials (CORS spec)
bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: withCredentials: false explicitly set on axios.get call for /health/live endpoint
bug_fix_verification.verification_result: FIXED - Button now works correctly in <1 second
